baseline_reference.scope: Historical optimized 32-substep baseline used by these reduced-step runs, preserved byte-for-byte. The current optimized32 report may describe later exact query optimizations; these observations retain their original input hashes.

limitations: Passing the predeclared engineering checks is specific to these two insertion tasks; it is not a material calibration, global stability proof, or a proven minimum timestep budget.

Sparse force RMS observations interpolate seven or more saved post-entry snapshots over shared physical time, without time warping. They do not resolve every contact transition and have no pass threshold.
Passing exit/peak/balance checks does not establish convergence of full force histories or coupled energy. Reduced-step force differences can be nonmonotonic.

The 8-substep cases terminate before contact loads. Their zero force and near-zero tissue displacement cannot be interpreted as an accurate contact result. Their raw case exit_error_m field is the stopped tip-to-target distance; no physical exit occurred, so the summary reports actual exit error as null.
Correctness jobs shared the GPU; their elapsed wall time and the extra accepted-state recorder overhead are not FPS measurements.
Full sparse traces remain unchanged in the hashed raw case reports; detailed accepted traces and byte-identical harness copies are retained in the ignored result directories.

handling_qualification.scope: Matched post-entry pulse interval 1.6–2.4 s; own timestep prelude, identical restored start within each pair. Not a global-insertion peak comparison or physiological calibration.

final_exact_query_optimization_validatio.scope: Exact radius-query reuse, finite-support surface query extent, surface launch block32; no physical law, coefficient, or numerical budget change

eight_substep_failure_distinction.reported_guard: Unresolved tip or shaft displacement; reduce timestep to resolve needle radius and track spacing
eight_substep_failure_distinction.interpretation: The contact interface was unloaded and its solve converged. The displacement guard rejected underresolved rigid handling. Zero contact force and nearly undeformed tissue are not accurate contact results, and no physical exit occurred.

final_source_default10_gap_confirmation.exit_vector_bound: Benchmark metadata does not store the deformed marked-target vector. Each reported exit error is the norm of its actual tip-to-target vector. By the triangle inequality, the norm of the difference between two such vectors is at most the sum of their norms. The approximately 20.2 micrometre bound proves the existing 50 micrometre criterion; actual final exit-point differences are separate observations, not substituted error vectors.

state_validation_scope.accepted_state_finite: The example checks particle/rigid states after each accepted substep; no failure occurred.
state_validation_scope.final_validation: The shared runner used --test and calls test_final after the synchronized frame loop: finite states, positive tetrahedron orientation, fixed nodes at rest.

limitations: Additional final-source gap confirmation, not a rerun of every historical per-substep state recorder or handling pulse.
Track quadrature sample counts are 25 at 10 substeps versus 26 at 32; track-length changes are retained as observations without a new threshold.
Peak, exit, event and balance agreement does not establish full force-history convergence, a global stability guarantee, physiological calibration or a proven minimum timestep budget.
Force/moment balance fields measure force-law scatter, not every finite-tolerance applied coupling iterate.
These raw runs also support separately defined unprofiled timings; no new timing claim is introduced by this validation section.
